name: Understood Care
long_description:
The American healthcare system is complicated. 88% of US adults cite difficulties navigating the healthcare system. 

The good news is patient advocacy became a covered benefit by Medicare in 2024. 

Understood Care matches Medicare patients with a healthcare personal assistant (known as a Patient Advocate) at little to no cost to the patient. Patient Advocates help patients patients access care - finding resources, helping fill out paperwork, and much more. 

Understood Care uses AI and healthcare expertise to deliver the highest quality patient advocacy to the 68 million Medicare patients in the US.
one_liner: Healthcare personal assistants for Medicare patients.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Understood Care advocacy will greatly reduce non-medical barriers to care for Medicare patients.Patient advocacy has two fundamental components - a search component and a delivery component.As an example, a common problem for our patients is around transportation. Patients who can no longer drive need alternative transportation to go to doctor’s appointments, shops and social events. However, there are two main issues:\* **Search problem:** Though there are county, state, insurance and non-profit sponsored transportation programs, they are not well advertised. Each program has their own bespoke qualification criteria. Patients can’t tell find the right solution.\* **Delivery problem:** The application process for a program usually involves long forms asking for extensive information. Patients need help completing paperwork.At Understood Care, we are solving both problems with the use of AI agents.Our advocate agent centralizes and progressively learns from the collective expertise of every Understood Care advocate as well as previous successful patient encounter to confidently identify and predict with the most relevant, accurate, and statistically best solution for our advocates to present to the patient.Our workflow agent automates tasks such as form completion and real-time note-taking, helping our advocates solve the patient’s problem faster.

launches.title: Understood Care: AI Powered Patient Advocacy
launches.tagline: Delivering high quality, Medicare covered patient advocacy to the 68 million Medicare patients in the US.
launches.body:
### **What is Understood Care?**

[Understood Care](https://understoodcare.com/) is a virtual patient advocacy platform for patients with Medicare.  

Advocates are administrative assistants with healthcare expertise that unblock access to care for patients. Advocates can help patients find transportation, schedule appointments, apply for financial aid and much more. We use AI to help advocates deliver superior advocacy at scale. 

Patient advocacy became a new Medicare covered benefit in 2024. Most Understood Care patients pay $0 out of pocket.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93210&key=user_uploads/1753723/334db23e-a29e-4633-bfb1-57c94259e184)

### **The Problem**

The American healthcare system is notoriously complex. 72% of insured adults lack confidence in managing their health insurance and benefits.

For the **68 million Medicare beneficiaries,** these challenges are even greater. Barriers in technology, finances, and health literacy often keep Medicare patients from accessing care, driving worse health outcomes and higher costs to the system.

The number of patients experiencing this problem is only growing. By 2030, the number of Medicare beneficiaries is projected to reach 80 million. 

### **How does Understood Care work?**

1️⃣ Patient signs up on website or by calling in.

2️⃣ We check the patient’s insurance eligibility and complete a patient intake with our clinical team.

3️⃣ We get the patient matched with the advocate that best fits their needs.

4️⃣ The advocate uses Understood Care’s clinical expertise and AI tools to resolve each patient’s unique care needs.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeu763mRuapSrYOVLGo_5FCjlG0c_9dUyncnOXfW1wNKvcmZr9Y51pfCvcFMcNAfe12p3dyfLAXTWQH9PkJ-IHExh3SWaC7KPoplpAYsE_YRTVWE2TUkHG3YlUAMB0vLHLO7YptTw?key=MP2f1P5qm-uzbzkuGXiGIg)

Examples of problems we’ve helped patients tackle:

⚠️ **Problem:** Patient could no longer drive to his appointments.

✅ **Solution:** We set the patient up with free county medical transportation. 

⚠️ **Problem:** The patient did not have money to afford proper food.

✅ **Solution:** We signed the patient up for a program that delivers free nutritious meals to low income seniors. 

⚠️ **Problem:** Patient received a new diagnosis and was overwhelmed.

✅ **Solution:** We helped the patient go over the doctor’s instructions and scheduled appointments with in network specialists.

### **Milestones**

⭐ We helped our first patient in April and are currently supporting 300+ patients.

⭐ Active in 40 states.

⭐ Able to accept Medicare, UHC, Humana and Aetna (top 3 Medicare Advantage plans).

### **Team**

Understood Care is built by a team fluent in AI, healthcare operations, and clinical care. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93210&key=user_uploads/1753723/e2f97acd-32f9-42d0-a5e0-5236e7ff6646)

[Sam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samanthawu/) (CEO) was an operator at several high growth healthcare tech startups including Finni, SiteRx, and Cedar. Ex-Carlyle, ex-Evercore. 

[Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-bailey-2951b0162/) (CTO) was a previous 2x founder (1x in browser tech, 1x in enterprise VDI). Ex- Uber/Postmates.

[Dr. Adam Bonder ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-j-bonder-md-mba-83b7a254/)(Medical Director) was previously the Medical Director at a VC backed behavioral health practice and is a actively practicing ER doc.

### **Asks**

✔️ Please share [our website ](https://understoodcare.com/)with friends or family that could benefit from our services. 

✔️ Please help us spread the word to other healthcare and community organizations - we accept [referrals](https://understoodcare.com/refer) through our website.

✔️ Give us a follow on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/understood-care) and [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/understoodcare).

launches.title: 🍃 Ply Health: Get providers in network faster
launches.tagline: We use AI to get behavioral health providers in network, so they can start billing twice as fast.
launches.body:
### tl;dr

Providers need to get in network with insurance companies, but the process is time-consuming and an administrative headache. We ingest provider information and use AI to automate submissions, saving providers months of waiting.

### ❌ The Problem

Being in network with a health insurer is critical for both patients and providers:

* For patients, seeing in network providers means dramatically lower healthcare costs. This informs which providers they choose and whether they can even afford to visit one.
* For providers, being in network means a bigger pool of potential patients. It also simplifies billing and reimbursement.

However, the process of getting a provider in network is highly manual and fragmented. There are approximately **1,400** payers in the US, each with their own enrollment process. Some of these processes involve painstakingly filling out 50+ page forms.

On top of burning hours of administrator time, delays are costly. A single incorrect field can push back cases by months. With providers billing $3,000/week, this costs healthcare practices **tens of thousands of dollars per provider**.

### ⭐ Our Solution

We provide standardized questionnaires to collect all required provider information and documents. Our customers are then able to request a new network enrollment in just a few clicks instead of spending hours navigating insurance websites to find the correct forms.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcMXSY2xKtBcO4T1bMrr_zU44eg-Shd1X_9JaM3loR6QgKdsuVHkOByIopdf09h2mBDLkIN563IS6LnLwhLnwQrvpoJKiG3qxYI6sAyIFgs6VCP0o-Eq-Y4niQc9koDRqzATtjI71T-pZFVZCBWP1jRbrE?key=qI7khypm2_NJ8SwqwOuqbw)

On the backend, we’re automating each part of the enrollment process. We also have an experienced ops team as humans-in-the-loop to make sure everything is processed correctly. This ensures that enrollments are completed quickly and accurately, our customers’ two most important KPIs.

Our product is currently optimized for behavioral health providers. We are working quickly to expand into other specialties. 

### 📈 Results with Ply

We are currently working with practices such as Finni Health, Legion Health, Anna Autism Care, Shasta Health, and Birches Health. 

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVVy8FtGG_dzB_Ok3lF30vt2HSlARjOP6gSLJxnRd52W9JDim6lUK79dMrMHCBKQrOW21-FgFVzw7PUXMc5dw2zQqJG6_dRPQ9l-0d1QQl8c4IN-lLTWQeuxSPjZweagiSJcKRq-hjVWkkud8rI_oBCU2k?key=qI7khypm2_NJ8SwqwOuqbw)

For our customers, we’re getting in network **2x - 3x** **faster** compared to alternative solutions, helping them earn additional **hundreds of thousands of dollars** in billing revenue.

### 🧑‍💻 The team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81329&key=user_uploads/1753723/1187d057-d8f6-4f2d-9472-44b209b86df4)

_We’ve been friends for over 15 years but don't actually have pictures together because we’re both camera shy_

**Sam** started her career in finance (M&A IB, then large cap PE) before realizing that she was meant to be a startup operator. She discovered the pain point of contracting and credentialing first hand when she was running BizOps at Finni Health. 

**David** is a pre-med turned software engineer with a specialty in building scalable backend systems at Meta and Snap. 

## 🙏 The ask

If you’re a behavioral health practice or are friends with one, we’d love to chat! Please reach out at [hello@plyhealth.com](mailto:hello@plyhealth.com) or book a demo on our [website](https://www.plyhealth.com/). 

If you’re at a behavioral health insurance payer, or are friends with one, we’d love to chat about potential partnerships. Please reach out at [hello@plyhealth.com](mailto:hello@plyhealth.com).

If nothing else, we’d appreciate sharing our launch and following us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/plyhealth)!
